title: Pulsed Pre-Harvest UV-B (310nm) Irradiation for 3-Fold Expansion of Sulforaphane Content in Broccoli Microgreens
author: Dr. vmffkxhs2362
abstract: Sulforaphane, derived from glucoraphanin hydrolysis, is a potent anti-cancer isothiocyanate. We applied targeted UV-B pulses (310nm LED, $5\text{ kJ/m}^2$) 24 hours before harvesting broccoli microgreens (*Brassica oleracea* var. *italica*). Transcriptional up-regulation of *CYP79F1* and *MYB28* transcription factors yielded a 310% increase in sulforaphane accumulation without compromising fresh weight yield.
key_findings: Pre-harvest UV-B treatment expanded sulforaphane concentration from 1.4 mg/g DW to 5.74 mg/g DW.
Myrosinase enzymatic cleavage kinetics increased 2.4-fold upon cell disruption.
Market value per tray increased 45% due to certified high-potency functional food status.
